_doc: Config for the daily house-hunt routine. The scheduled job: (1) fetches each source in sources.json into raw/, (2) runs match.py to reconcile + score + diff + update the watchlist, (3) posts the board to Slack, (4) reads new thread replies on listing posts to add houses to the watchlist.
_schedule_note: Started daily; dial back to e.g. '0 8 * * 0,1,3,5' (Sun/Mon/Wed/Fri) if it gets noisy.

delivery._security: NEVER commit the webhook URL. It is an incoming-webhook secret kept OUTSIDE this repo (currently in ~/.claude). At run time the agent reads it from the HOUSE_HUNT_SLACK_WEBHOOK env var (or the existing ~/.claude entry) and POSTs the board. Confirm #housing-updates == channel C0B9JHL9NE9.
delivery.format: ASCII board now; richer cards later

watchlist_intake._doc: To add a house to the sold-price tracker, reply in its Slack thread. Each run, the agent scans threads on listing posts for new replies, extracts the listing address/URL, and appends to watchlist.json. Replies are matched back to the listing by the post they're under.

data_home._doc: No external DB. The committed state files in this folder ARE the datastore ('fake DB'), same pattern as bracket-challenge: each run reads the prior state, writes the new state, and the routine git-commits + pushes it so it survives to the next run. raw/ is transient and NOT committed.
data_home.persist: at end of run, stage these paths, commit, and push to origin/main
